name: ap-optimal-claude
description: Optimized Claude Code workflow kit: auto-updating hooks (session-context loading, a check-your-work nudge on stop, pre-commit status, delegate-findings measurement, memory-write nudge, a key check that blocks API keys written into files, a safety guard for deletes and for personal folders), handoff system, project documentation skills, outcome-grading loops, and specialist agents (architect, code-verifier, mechanic) that tag every finding as reproduced or unverified. Pair with the claude-setup.py bootstrapper for permission guardrails and the ccx launcher.
